entry.title: Encount★Sunrise×Stars!!: Older Brother's Nightmare
entry.content:
Characters
Release Date
2024/10/31
Translation
Miialona
Proofreading
N/A

Location: Central Street 1 (Night)

Ohh~ woah. Helios Tower's super big huh

Hehehe, New Million at night.... It's nice, I'm growing to enjoy it♪

I'm also pretty fond of it. I hope you enjoyed the nightlife.

Sure did. I hope we've all three of us made sweet memories tonight♪

...

Brad-san has been awfully quiet hm. Is he always like that?

No no.

Hmmm... even in front of Faith?

Huh? Yea, even in front of me...

Isn't your older brother the same?

My Anija huh, in front of me he becomes incredibly stupid.

Stupid...?

To put it simply, his intelligence level drops dramatically and, he starts fawning over me to get me to be friendly to him.

Is that so...? Even when he acts like that, you don't act friendly towards him?

That sort of behaviour makes me feel grossed out. He just doesn't get it, he's too stupid.

...?

Brad-san. Always keep an appropriate distance to your brother okay?

Whatever you do, under no circumstances, must you ever show off a Faith plushie in public, it's absolutely forbidden.

Plushie...?

They make plushies of heroes right? I happened to notice them being sold in the tower but... you haven't already bought one, right?

I've never bought one...

That's good. It seems we were able to prevent a catastrophe.

Ritsu's older brother really dotes on him eh. He sounds like an interesting guy.

He's not interesting at all. Well, it's kinda funny, because I have such overwhelming power over him, I can basically get away with anything.

Eeh, what kind of things?

Swearing, kicking... shooting with a gattling gun?

A gattling gun?

The gun uses soybeans instead of bullets though. That whole thing happened during an event a while ago.

Well, Anija told me to do it but, shooting him was fun...♪

What the.... Well I don't entirely understand you but, Ritsu's also pretty interesting eh?

Heheheh. Maybe Faith should occasionally do that kind of thing to his oniichan too?

Aha, I wouldn't wish for my jokes to go that far

...

Location: West Sector Living Room (Day)

— A few days later.

Are you there, Faith?

(...? Is he in his room?)

Location: Junior & Faith's Room (Day)

Faith

... Brad?

There you are. I just wanted to check a couple things regarding Ritsu's arrival. Do you mind for a bit?

...

... Faith?

You came at the just right time, I have business with you, I was just getting things ready

Getting what ready...?

This gattling gun...!

!?

Location: West Sector Living Room (Day)

Stop! Faith!

It's okay, these are just boring old beans!

Why beans...!

Don't you know... you probably know more about it anyways? Isn't it some kind of Japanese tradition!?

Kuh...

Location: Hallway 3 (Day)

Running away is pointless, Brad! I'll chase after you to the ends of the earth to pelt you with beans...!

Why are you doing this... tch, Faith!

Why? ... obviously, because I'm your "younger brother"!?

Younger brothers of this world can get away with anything they do to their older brothers! Don't you get it?

I've never heard of anything like that...!

Seriously? An older brother refusing to do what his younger brother wants is a violation of the law, do you want to be arrested or something?

What...!?

Look, look. If you don't want to break the law, take the barrage of beans obediently...!

Aha, this is starting to get fun... let's keep going! Pow pow pow pow pow...☆

Please stop, Faith-...!

Location: Brad & Oscar's Room (Lights Out)

Hmph!?

Haah... Hah.... Was it all a dream...

Are you okay, Brad-sama?

O-Oscar...

You we're making pained groaning sounds, I was wondering if I should have woken you up.

If you're feeling unwell, shall I bring you some medication...

I'm okay, don't worry. I just... had a really unexpected dream.

An unexpected dream?

My apologies for waking you up all of a sudden. Honestly, I'm already feeling better, you should rest.

I-I understand.... Please sleep well too, Brad-sama

Mmm...

(Ritsu's older brother... Rei, was it?)

(At the end of the day, we never got to meet each other, I wonder what sort of interesting person we would have met...)

(Hopefully, those brothers spend time getting along with each other where they've gone back to)

(... So, no one has to be pelted by beans again)
